Exchange your voucher and then go somewhere else
Aug 2018 • Solo
I decided to go to this restaurant because this seemed to be the only place where I could exchange my Sapaly Train Voucher for the train back to Hanoi.

While they managed to exchange my voucher for a ticket, they could not help me with a request regarding that ticket (I was assigned the wrong berth/cabin).

The food itself (fried noodles with chicken) was overcooked and lacked taste. One of the family next to me had ordered cheeseburgers but got burgers without cheese. First, they had trouble getting their request to get what they ordered understood and then only received their dish after the rest of their family was already done eating. (Also: no fries, although the picture in the menu had promised otherwise.)

There was no aircon and the fans on the ceiling barely did their job. Their bathroom, which I had hoped would allow to freshen up a bit before the train journey, was smelly and not particularly clean.

Conclusion: Check whether you can exchange your ticket someplace else. If you can do. If not, don't stay for dinner.
